test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with the most appropriate option.

Each one of the participants in the annual function ________ an applause.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 4)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the singular form of the verb 'deserves' is correct because the subject 'Each one of the participants' is singular.
 
• The verb must agree with the subject in number and person.
 
• Since **'Each one'** is singular, it requires the **singular form of the verb** **'deserves'**.
 
 
• **Example:** *Each one of the students **deserves** a reward.*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the singular form of the verb 'deserves' is the correct choice.

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Another option here doesn't suit with the tense of the verb and number of the subjects.
 
• Option 1) is deserving = **Incorrect **( As present continuous tense doesn't suit with this sentence here)
 
• Option 2) have deserved =** Incorrect **( As Present perfect tense is not justifiable here and 'have' is a plural helping verb here ) 
 
• Option 3) deserve =** Incorrect **(As the subject of the sentence is a 3rd person singular and it requires an additional 's' with the verb.
